name: TQQQ Buy and Hold
description: Buy TQQQ at the start close and hold it. Total return, adjusted closes.

data_source.label: Yahoo Finance free daily prices
data_source.banner: FREE SOURCE — Yahoo Finance daily prices. This book does not select a stock universe, so S&P 500 survivorship bias does not apply. Sharadar is still the intended replacement for vendor-adjusted free prices.

caveats: FREE SOURCE — Yahoo Finance daily prices. This book does not pick stocks from the S&P 500, so index survivorship bias does not apply. The bars are still vendor-adjusted free data. Sharadar SEP is the intended price replacement.
Buy-and-hold is 100% TQQQ. Total return uses Yahoo's adjusted close, so the small TQQQ dividend is included.
The position is entered at the first mark's close. There is no high-water-mark rule in this book.
This is not the memorandum's two-bullet rule. That book is reported separately.
Transaction cost is 0 bps on the entry notional.

metrics.sharpe_basis: annualized daily simple returns, rf=0, 252-day year

benchmark.name: S&P 500 (SPY)
benchmark.note: SPY adjusted close (total return), rebased to this book's starting capital on the book's first date. Reference only.
